name: Spoils of War
label: Quest
description: Spoils of War: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!
What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!
Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
